summary: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to redefine a tipped employee as any worker whose tips plus required cash wages meet the full federal minimum wage over an employer-chosen work period such as a day or week, replacing the prior $30-per-month threshold.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly modifies the definition of a 'tipped employee' under the Fair Labor Standards Act, which impacts wage regulations for a specific group of workers. By broadening the definition and allowing employers to determine the work period for tip calculations, it provides more flexibility to employers regarding how they classify and pay tipped workers, potentially reducing the number of employees who qualify for the full federal minimum wage regardless of tips.
